title: On Passing the gate at a run
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：pass　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pass 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the porter ① passed the gate at a run in public, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② passes the gate at a run in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pass the gate at a run at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ passed the gate at a run before — a line in the journal for August 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Passing the gate at a run in public, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pass him the cup without a word in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pass him the cup without a word at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ passes him the cup without a word in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ passed the gate at a run again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pass the gate at a run, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody passes the gate at a run in silence again and somebody must pass the gate at a run in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 经过（一般过去式 passed the gate at a run：1951 年挑夫头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 经过（一般现在 passes the gate at a run：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 经过（不定式 to pass the gate at a run：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 经过（过去完成时 had passed the gate at a run：1945 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 经过（动名词 passing the gate at a run 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 递给（pass him the cup without a word：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去递给一句话没说把杯子递给他）
G. v. 递给（pass him the cup without a word：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 经过（后段两处：新来的游客照例 passes him the cup without a word，而母亲又一次 passed the gate at a run）

answers.why: pass 意为“经过”，1951 年挑夫当着众人面经过跑着经过那道门口，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 passed。
pass 意为“经过”，自那以后挑夫一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 passes。
pass 意为“经过”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯经过跑着经过那道门口”，此处为不定式 to pass the gate at a run。
pass 意为“经过”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人经过过，故用过去完成时 had passed。
pass 意为“经过”，挑夫说“经过跑着经过那道门口这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 passing the gate at a run 作主语。
pass 意为“递给”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去递给一句话没说把杯子递给他”，should ever 之后用原形 pass him the cup without a word。
pass 意为“递给”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻递给一句话没说把杯子递给他（pass him the cup without a word at once），以后再也不要提起。
pass 意为“经过”，新来的游客每个星期都照例递给一句话没说把杯子递给他，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 passes。
pass 意为“经过”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面经过跑着经过那道门口，用一般过去式 passed 叙述。
pass 意为“经过”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要经过跑着经过那道门口，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，挑夫当着众人面经过跑着经过那道门口；海岸里每一个游客都说这是头一回。（passed the gate at a run）
多年以后，挑夫仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（passes the gate at a run）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯经过跑着经过那道门口这件事本身。（to pass the gate at a run）
早在 1945 年就有人经过跑着经过那道门口，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had passed the gate at a run）
挑夫说过，当着众人面经过跑着经过那道门口这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（passing the gate at a run 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻递给一句话没说把杯子递给他，以后再也不要提起。（pass him the cup without a word，祈使句）
answers: In 1951 the porter passed the gate at a run in public, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the porter still passes the gate at a run in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to pass the gate at a run at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had passed the gate at a run long before 1958, and the line in the journal for August proves it.
Passing the gate at a run in public, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Pass him the cup without a word at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pass 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the porter passed the gate at a run in public, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter passes the gate at a run in silence whenever the coast asks.
Passing the gate at a run in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pass him the cup without a word in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast passes him the cup without a word in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother passed the gate at a run again, and the coast remembered that half.
